name: America
summary: Founding Fathers. Uniques: Film Studio (building, replaces Broadcast Center), P-51 Mustang (unit, replaces Fighter)

ability: Founding Fathers: All Diplomatic policy slots in the current government are converted to Wildcard slots. +1 Diplomatic Favor per turn for every Wildcard slot in their government.

name: Arabia
summary: The Last Prophet. Uniques: Madrasa (building, replaces University), Mamluk (unit, replaces Knight)

ability: The Last Prophet: Automatically receive the final Great Prophet when the next-to-last one is claimed (if you have not earned a Great Prophet already). +1 Science for each foreign city following Arabia's Religion.

name: Australia
summary: Land Down Under. Uniques: Outback Station (improvement), Digger (unit, replaces Infantry)

ability: Land Down Under: +3 Housing in coastal cities. Pastures trigger a Culture Bomb. Yields from Campuses, Commercial Hubs, Holy Sites and Theater Squares are +1 in tiles with Charming Appeal, +3 in Breathtaking.

name: Aztec
summary: Legend of the Five Suns. Uniques: Tlachtli (building, replaces Arena), Eagle Warrior (unit, replaces Warrior)

ability: Legend of the Five Suns: Spend Builder charges to complete 20% of the original district cost.

name: Babylon
summary: Enuma Anu Enlil. Uniques: Palgum (building, replaces Water Mill), Sabum Kibittum (unit)

ability: Enuma Anu Enlil: Eurekas provide all of the Science for technologies. -50% Science per turn.

name: Brazil
summary: Amazon. Uniques: Street Carnival (district, replaces Entertainment Complex), Copacabana (district, replaces Water Park), Minas Geraes (unit, replaces Battleship)

ability: Amazon: Rainforest tiles provide +1 adjacency bonus for Campus, Commercial Hub, Holy Site, and Theater Square districts, and grant +1 Appeal to adjacent tiles, instead of the usual -1.

name: Byzantium
summary: Taxis. Uniques: Hippodrome (district, replaces Entertainment Complex), Dromon (unit, replaces Quadrireme)

ability: Taxis: Units receive +3 Combat Strength or Religious Strength for each Holy City converted to Byzantium's Religion (including Byzantium's Holy City). Byzantium's Religion is spread to nearby cities when defeating a unit belonging to an enemy civilization or city-state. +1 Great Prophet point from cities with a Holy Site district.

name: Canada
summary: Four Faces of Peace. Uniques: Ice Hockey Rink (improvement), Mountie (unit)

ability: Four Faces of Peace: Cannot declare war on City-States or surprise wars. Surprise wars cannot be declared on Canada. For every 100 Tourism per turn earn 1 Diplomatic Favor per turn. Receive +100% Diplomatic Favor from successfully completing an Emergency or Scored Competition.

name: China
summary: Dynastic Cycle. Uniques: Great Wall (improvement), Crouching Tiger (unit)

ability: Dynastic Cycle: Eurekas and Inspirations provide 50% of civics and technologies instead of 40%. When completing a wonder receive a random Eureka and Inspiration from the era of the wonder, if available.

name: Cree
summary: Nîhithaw. Uniques: Mekewap (improvement), Okihtcitaw (unit, replaces Scout)

ability: Nîhithaw: +1 Trade Route capacity and a free Trader with the Pottery technology. Unclaimed tiles within 3 tiles of a Cree city come under Cree control when a Trader first moves into them.

name: Egypt
summary: Iteru. Uniques: Sphinx (improvement), Maryannu Chariot Archer (unit)

ability: Iteru: +15% Production towards districts and wonders if placed next to a River. Does not receive damage from Floods.

name: England
summary: Workshop of the World. Uniques: Royal Navy Dockyard (district, replaces Harbor), Sea Dog (unit, replaces Privateer)

ability: Workshop of the World: Iron and Coal Mines accumulate 2 more resources per turn. +100% Production towards Military Engineers. Military Engineers receive +2 charges. Buildings that provide additional yields when Powered receive +4 of that yield. +20% Production towards Industrial Zone buildings. Harbor buildings increase Strategic Resource Stockpiles by +10 (on Standard Speed).

name: Ethiopia
summary: Aksumite Legacy. Uniques: Rock-Hewn Church (improvement), Oromo Cavalry (unit, replaces Courser)

ability: Aksumite Legacy: Ethiopia’s International Trade Routes grant +0.5 Faith per resource at the origin. Improved resources provide +1 Faith for each copy the city owns. Can purchase Archaeological Museums and Archaeologists with Faith.

name: France
summary: Grand Tour. Uniques: Château (improvement), Garde Impériale (unit, replaces Line Infantry)

ability: Grand Tour: +20% Production toward Medieval, Renaissance, and Industrial era wonders. Tourism from wonders of any era is +100%.

name: Gaul
summary: Hallstatt Culture. Uniques: Oppidum (district, replaces Industrial Zone), Gaesatae (unit, replaces Warrior)

ability: Hallstatt Culture: Mines provide a minor adjacency bonus for all districts, a Culture Bomb of unowned territory, and receive +1 Culture. Specialty districts do not receive a minor adjacency for being adjacent to another district and these districts cannot be built adjacent to the City Center.

name: Georgia
summary: Strength in Unity. Uniques: Tsikhe (building, replaces Renaissance Walls), Khevsur (unit, replaces Man-At-Arms)

ability: Strength in Unity: When making Dedications at the beginning of a Golden Age or Heroic Age, receive the Normal Age bonus towards improving Era Score in addition to the other bonus. +50% Production towards defensive buildings.

name: Germany
summary: Free Imperial Cities. Uniques: Hansa (district, replaces Industrial Zone), U-Boat (unit, replaces Submarine)

ability: Free Imperial Cities: Each city can build one more district than usual (exceeding the normal limit based on Citizen Population).

name: Gran Colombia
summary: Ejército Patriota. Uniques: Comandante General (unit), Hacienda (improvement), Llanero (unit, replaces Cavalry)

ability: Ejército Patriota: +1 Movement to all units. Promoting a unit does not end that unit’s turn.

name: Greece
summary: Plato's Republic. Uniques: Acropolis (district, replaces Theater Square), Hoplite (unit, replaces Spearman)

ability: Plato's Republic: One extra Wildcard policy slot in any government.

name: Hungary
summary: Pearl of the Danube. Uniques: Thermal Bath (building, replaces Zoo), Huszár (unit, replaces Cavalry)

ability: Pearl of the Danube: +50% Production to Districts and Buildings constructed across a river from a City Center.

name: Inca
summary: Mit’a. Uniques: Terrace Farm (improvement), Warak’aq (unit, replaces Skirmisher)

ability: Mit’a: Citizens may work Mountain tiles. Mountain tiles provide +2 Production and an additional +1 Production when the game reaches the Industrial Era. +1 Food to Mountain tiles for every adjacent Terrace Farm.

name: India
summary: Dharma. Uniques: Stepwell (improvement), Varu (unit)

ability: Dharma: Receives Follower Belief bonuses in a city from each Religion that has at least 1 Follower. Cities gain an Amenity for every Religion with at least 1 Follower. Missionaries have +2 spreads. +100% Religious pressure from your Trade Routes.

name: Indonesia
summary: Great Nusantara. Uniques: Kampung (improvement), Jong (unit, replaces Frigate)

ability: Great Nusantara: Coast and Lake tiles provide a minor adjacency bonus for Holy Site, Campus, Industrial Zone, and Theater Square districts. +1 Amenity from entertainment to each Entertainment Complex adjacent to a Coast or Lake tile.

name: Japan
summary: Meiji Restoration. Uniques: Electronics Factory (building, replaces Factory), Samurai (unit, replaces Man-At-Arms)

ability: Meiji Restoration: All districts receive an additional standard adjacency bonus for being adjacent to another district.

name: Khmer
summary: Grand Barays. Uniques: Prasat (building, replaces Temple), Domrey (unit, replaces Trebuchet)

ability: Grand Barays: Cities with an Aqueduct receive +1 Amenity from entertainment and +1 Faith for every Citizen population. Farms provide +2 Food if adjacent to an Aqueduct and +1 Faith if adjacent to a Holy Site.

name: Kongo
summary: Nkisi. Uniques: Mbanza (district, replaces Neighborhood), Ngao Mbeba (unit, replaces Swordsman)

ability: Nkisi: +2 Food, +2 Production, +1 Faith, and +4 Gold from each Relic, Artifact, and Sculpture Great Work of Art in addition to the usual Culture. Receive 50% more Great Artist, Great Musician, and Great Merchant points. Palace has slots for 5 Great Works.

name: Korea
summary: Three Kingdoms. Uniques: Seowon (district, replaces Campus), Hwacha (unit, replaces Field Cannon)

ability: Three Kingdoms: Mines receive +1 Science for every adjacent Seowon district. Farms receive +1 Food for every adjacent Seowon district.

name: Macedon
summary: Hellenistic Fusion. Uniques: Basilikoi Paides (building, replaces Barracks), Hypaspist (unit, replaces Swordsman)

ability: Hellenistic Fusion: Receive boosts upon city conquest: a Eureka for each Encampment or Campus in the conquered city and an Inspiration for each Holy Site or Theater Square.

name: Mali
summary: Songs of the Jeli. Uniques: Suguba (district, replaces Commercial Hub), Mandekalu Cavalry (unit, replaces Knight)

ability: Songs of the Jeli: City Centers gain +1 Faith and +1 Food for every adjacent Desert and Desert Hills tiles. Mines receive -1 Production and +4 Gold. May purchase Commercial Hub district buildings with Faith. -30% Production toward constructing buildings or training units.

name: Māori
summary: Mana. Uniques: Marae (building, replaces Amphitheater), Pā (improvement), Toa (unit, replaces Swordsman)

ability: Mana: Begin the game with the Sailing and Shipbuilding technologies unlocked and with the ability to enter Ocean tiles. Embarked units gain +2 Movement. Unimproved Woods and Rainforest are +1 Production. Additional +1 Production from Mercantilism and +2 Production from Conservation. Fishing Boats provide +1 Food and a Culture Bomb to adjacent tiles. Resources cannot be harvested. Great Writers cannot be earned.

name: Mapuche
summary: Toqui. Uniques: Chemamull (improvement), Malón Raider (unit)

ability: Toqui: Cities with an Established Governor provide +5% Culture, +5% Production, and +10% experience in combat towards all units trained in this city. These numbers are tripled in cities not founded by the Mapuche. All cities within 9 tiles of a city with your Governor gain +4 Loyalty per turn towards your civilization.

name: Maya
summary: Mayab. Uniques: Observatory (district, replaces Campus), Hul'che (unit, replaces Archer)

ability: Mayab: Settling adjacent to Fresh Water and Coast does not provide extra Housing, instead each Farm provides an additional +1 Housing, +1 Production for every adjacent Observatory, and +1 Gold. +1 Amenity for every Luxury adjacent to the City Center.

name: Mongolia
summary: Örtöö. Uniques: Ordu (building, replaces Stable), Keshig (unit)

ability: Örtöö: Starting a Trade Route immediately creates a Trading Post in the destination city. Receive an extra level of Vis Limited Diplomatic Visibility for possessing a Trading Post in any city of a civilization. All Mongolian units double the usual Combat Bonus for having a higher level of Vis Limited Diplomatic Visibility than their opponent.

name: Netherlands
summary: Grote Rivieren. Uniques: Polder (improvement), De Zeven Provinciën (unit, replaces Frigate)

ability: Grote Rivieren: Major adjacency bonus for Campuses, Theater Squares, and Industrial Zones if next to a river. Culture Bomb adjacent tiles when completing a Harbor. +50% Production toward the Dam district and Flood Barrier building.

name: Norway
summary: Knarr. Uniques: Stave Church (building, replaces Temple), Berserker (unit, replaces Man-At-Arms)

ability: Knarr: Units gain the ability to enter Ocean tiles after researching the Shipbuilding technology. Naval melee units heal in neutral territory. Units ignore additional Movement costs from embarking and disembarking.

name: Nubia
summary: Ta-Seti. Uniques: Nubian Pyramid (improvement), Pítati Archer (unit, replaces Archer)

ability: Ta-Seti: +30% Production toward Ranged units. All Ranged units gain +50% combat experience. Mines over strategic resources provide +1 Production. Mines over bonus and luxury resources provide +2 Gold.

name: Ottomans
summary: Great Turkish Bombard. Uniques: Grand Bazaar (building, replaces Bank), Barbary Corsair (unit, replaces Privateer)

ability: Great Turkish Bombard: +50% Production toward siege units. All siege units gain +5 Combat Strength against district defenses. Conquered cities do not lose Citizen Population. Cities not founded by the Ottomans gain +1 Amenity and +4 Loyalty per turn.

name: Persia
summary: Satrapies. Uniques: Pairidaeza (improvement), Immortal (unit, replaces Swordsman)

ability: Satrapies: +1 Trade Route capacity with Political Philosophy civic. Receive +2 Gold and +1 Culture for routes between your own cities. Roads built in your territory are one level more advanced than usual.

name: Phoenicia
summary: Mediterranean Colonies. Uniques: Cothon (district, replaces Harbor), Bireme (unit, replaces Galley)

ability: Mediterranean Colonies: Begin the game with the Writing technology Eureka. Coastal cities founded by Phoenicia and located on the same continent as the Phoenician Capital are 100% Loyal. Settlers gain +2 Movement and +2 sight range while embarked. Settlers ignore additional Movement costs from embarking and disembarking.

name: Poland
summary: Golden Liberty. Uniques: Sukiennice (building, replaces Market), Winged Hussar (unit, replaces Cuirassier)

ability: Golden Liberty: Culture Bomb adjacent tiles when completing an Encampment or Fort inside friendly territory. One Military policy slot in the current government is converted to a Wildcard slot.

name: Portugal
summary: Casa da Índia. Uniques: Navigation School (building, replaces University), Feitoria (improvement), Nau (unit, replaces Caravel)

ability: Casa da Índia: International Trade Routes must originate from a coastal city and can only reach cities on the coast or with a Harbor, but receive +50% towards all yields. Trader units have +50% range over water, and can embark as soon as they are unlocked.

name: Rome
summary: All Roads Lead to Rome. Uniques: Bath (district, replaces Aqueduct), Legion (unit, replaces Swordsman)

ability: All Roads Lead to Rome: All cities you found or conquer start with a Trading Post. If in Trade Route range of your Capital, they also start with a road to it. Your Trade Routes earn +1 Gold for passing through Trading Posts in your own cities.

name: Russia
summary: Mother Russia. Uniques: Lavra (district, replaces Holy Site), Cossack (unit, replaces Cavalry)

ability: Mother Russia: Extra territory upon founding cities. +1 Faith and +1 Production from Tundra. Units do not receive damage from Blizzards. Civilizations that are at war with Russia receive +100% unit damage from Blizzards in Russian territory.

name: Scotland
summary: Scottish Enlightenment. Uniques: Golf Course (improvement), Highlander (unit, replaces Ranger)

ability: Scottish Enlightenment: Happy cities receive an additional +5% Science and +5% Production. Happy cities generate +1 Great Scientist point per Campus and +1 Great Engineer point per Industrial Zone. Ecstatic cities double all these amounts.

name: Scythia
summary: People of the Steppe. Uniques: Kurgan (improvement), Saka Horse Archer (unit)

ability: People of the Steppe: Receive a second light cavalry unit or Saka Horse Archer each time you train a light cavalry unit or Saka Horse Archer.

name: Spain
summary: Treasure Fleet. Uniques: Mission (improvement), Conquistador (unit, replaces Musketman)

ability: Treasure Fleet: May form Fleets and Armadas with Mercantilism, instead of Nationalism and Mobilization. Trade Routes receive +3 Gold, +2 Faith, and +1 Production. Trade Routes between multiple continents receive triple these numbers. Cities not on your original Capital’s continent receive +25% Production towards districts and a builder when founded.

name: Sumeria
summary: Epic Quests. Uniques: Ziggurat (improvement), War-Cart (unit)

ability: Epic Quests: When you capture a Barbarian Outpost, receive a Tribal Village reward in addition to the usual Gold. Pay half the usual cost to levy city-state units.

name: Sweden
summary: Nobel Prize. Uniques: Open-Air Museum (improvement), Carolean (unit, replaces Pike and Shot)

ability: Nobel Prize: Sweden gains 50 Diplomatic Favor when earning a Great Person (on Standard Speed). Sweden receives +1 Great Engineer point from Factories and +1 Great Scientist point from Universities. Having Sweden in the game adds three unique World Congress competitions starting in the Industrial Era.

name: Vietnam
summary: Nine Dragon River Delta. Uniques: Thành (district, replaces Encampment), Voi Chiến (unit, replaces Crossbowman)

ability: Nine Dragon River Delta: All land specialty districts can only be built on Rainforest, Marsh, or Woods. Receive the following yields for every building on these features: +1 Culture in Woods, +1 Science in Rainforest and +1 Production in Marsh. Woods can be planted with the Medieval Faires civic.

name: Zulu
summary: Isibongo. Uniques: Ikanda (district, replaces Encampment), Impi (unit, replaces Pikeman)

ability: Isibongo: Cities with a garrisoned unit get +3 Loyalty per turn, or +5 if it is a Corps or Army. Conquering a city with a unit will upgrade it into a Corps or Army, if the proper Civics are unlocked.
